subject: POC access & connectivity timeline: API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Avery Collins <avery.collins@cardiopulse.com>, Nadia Ortiz <nadia.ortiz@cardiopulse.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP draft + initial ask: API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering

Hi Avery and Nadia,

Thanks again for the demo last week — appreciate the clarity on your integration goals. I attached a working Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with recommended tasks and owners focused on the POC connectivity items you asked about. High-level ask from our side to keep the pilot timeline intact:

- Confirm org admin and a read-only IAM account for Redwood to validate tenant provisioning (we only need tenant metadata, no production data).
- Provide the low/med/high IP ranges for your API allowlist (we'll consume these for our egress rules).
- Approve a VPC peering window (2–4 hour slot) the week of Nov 22 so infra can do routing validation.

Quick proposed timeline in the MAP (sheet 2): Org setup + API keys (3 business days), IP allowlist applied (same day after keys), VPC peering dry-run and cutover (scheduled slot). If you agree, I’ll loop in Ben from our infra team to scope the peering template and Rachel to confirm onboarding steps and DocuSign.

Attached: MAP-CardioPulse-v1.xlsx (MAP), vpc-peering-template.txt (technical), api-key-onboarding-checklist.pdf (ops).

Next step: can you confirm the org admin contact and an IT point-of-contact for peering?

Thanks,

— Logan Wright
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0182

---
[attachments: MAP-CardioPulse-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), vpc-peering-template.txt (text), api-key-onboarding-checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: Nadia Ortiz <nadia.ortiz@cardiopulse.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Avery Collins <avery.collins@cardiopulse.com>
Cc: it-team@cardiopulse.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft + initial ask: API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering

Logan — thanks for this. MAP looks reasonable; a couple of clarifications from our side before we lock dates:

1) Org admin: that will be Avery (she's copied). We also want an explicit on-call engineer in case the peering window runs over.
2) IP allowlist: our security team prefers CIDR blocks rather than single IPs. We'll share three ranges: management, app-egress, and testing.
3) VPC peering: must pass our compliance pre-checks (NAT routing, no overlapping subnets). Can Ben send the peering template to our infra alias (it-team@cardiopulse.com) and we'll run the pre-check?

Tentative: Nov 23 or 24 for the peering window. If you can confirm Ben is available for a short pre-check call Nov 18, we'll aim for Nov 23.

Also, please note: procurement requires the MAP to include billing contact and CLA references before we sign the DocuSign envelope.

Best,

— Nadia Ortiz
Head of Trials, CardioPulse Health
nadia.ortiz@cardiopulse.com

---
[it-team@cardiopulse.com added on cc]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: it-team@cardiopulse.com, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Nadia Ortiz <nadia.ortiz@cardiopulse.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 14:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft + initial ask: API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering

Hi Nadia / CardioPulse infra team —

Thanks for the quick response. I attached the peering template you requested but pasted the key checklist below so your engineers can triage quickly:

Peering pre-check quick list:
- Confirm non-overlapping subnet ranges for Redwood and CardioPulse (we recommend Redwood use 10.40.0.0/16 if possible).
- Ensure route table allows the peer CIDR and there's a path back to the internet for health checks.
- No NAT required for internal API calls; we will use private IP routes once peered.
- BGP is not required for our setup; static routing is fine for the POC.

API key and org setup notes:
- We'll create a tenant scoped to your account. We need one org-admin email and one service account name for the API key. The API key will be created in our console and shared to your secure vault (or you can generate and provide).
- The api-key-onboarding-checklist.pdf lists the exact header names and example requests.

Availability: I can join a 30-min pre-check call on Nov 18 at 10am PT. If that works for your infra crew, please send a calendar invite to ben.carter@redwood.com and it-team@cardiopulse.com.

Regards,

— Ben Carter
Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

[attachment: vpc-peering-template.txt]

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Avery Collins <avery.collins@cardiopulse.com>, Nadia Ortiz <nadia.ortiz@cardiopulse.com>, it-team@cardiopulse.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft + initial ask: API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering — updated timeline and actions

Thanks all — quick status and agreed next steps so we have a single source of truth in the MAP: 

Actions and owners:
- CardioPulse: confirm three CIDR ranges for allowlist (management, app-egress, testing) — owner: Nadia — due Nov 16 EOD.
- Redwood infra: send final peering template + runbook — owner: Ben — sent Nov 12 (see attachment).
- CardioPulse infra: run pre-check and confirm no overlapping subnets — owner: it-team@cardiopulse.com — due Nov 18 (pre-check call).
- Redwood ops: provision tenant and generate API key (or provide instructions for customer-managed key) — owner: Rachel — targeted Nov 19.
- Legal/Procurement: finalize CLA and billing contact so DocuSign can be completed — owners: CardioPulse procurement + Logan — target Nov 20.

Target POC cutover window: Nov 23 09:00–13:00 PT (4-hour block). If we encounter route issues we'll have a fallback slot Nov 24 same window.

Please reply if any of the dates conflict with your internal approvals. I'll update MAP-CardioPulse-v1.xlsx with these commitments and share an updated Drive link.

Thanks — looking forward to the pre-check on Nov 18.

— Logan
